import openpyxl
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook('tasks/2-22/testbed/data/score.xlsx')
ws=wb.active
rows=list(ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True))
mid1=[r[1] for r in rows]
mid2=[r[2] for r in rows]
print('midterm1 avg', sum(mid1)/len(mid1), 'max', max(mid1), 'min', min(mid1))
print('midterm2 avg', sum(mid2)/len(mid2), 'max', max(mid2), 'min', min(mid2))
# per student aggregate
from collections import defaultdict
d=defaultdict(list)
for name,m1,m2 in rows:
    d[name].append((m1,m2))
for name in sorted(d):
    vals=d[name]
    avg1=sum(v[0] for v in vals)/len(vals)
    avg2=sum(v[1] for v in vals)/len(vals)
    print(name, 'count', len(vals), 'avg1', round(avg1,2), 'avg2', round(avg2,2))
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/compute_stats.py"}
